entry.headline: Weimar: half-awake, half-aware

entry.headline: Weimar: slow progress, stubborn habits

changes.title: Engine idling normalised
changes.story: Drivers wait with engines running; air quality dips slightly. A small habit, repeated daily.

changes.title: Gravel replaces lawn

changes.title: Fast food waste on benches

entry.headline: Weimar: uneven green shift, old habits persist

surprise.title: Silent aquifer stress emerges
surprise.story: Private pools and usual water habits drain groundwater. Wells drop 3m since 2063. Pool-fillers ignored warnings. By 2077, summer water rationing begins.

entry.headline: Weimar: green gains, old divides persist
entry.outlook: Weimar in 2077 is a town of contradictions: solar panels and insulated homes exist alongside pool-fillers and litter; cycling grows while the river remains neglected and aquifers stress; green gains mask deepening inequality.

changes.title: Summer water rationing enforced
changes.story: Pool-filling now restricted to twice monthly. Showers limited. River Ilm use monitored. Tension rises between private wealth and public scarcity.

changes.title: River cleanup halted by apathy
changes.story: Car-washing near river persists. No enforcement. Flow at 80% but banks littered. Aquatic life scarce. Restoration funds redirected to rationing infrastructure.

changes.title: Insulation spreads, unequally
changes.story: Three households now heavily insulated; heating cuts 40%. Solar on 15% of roofs. Retrofitting costs exclude poorer districts. Energy inequality widens.
